items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: So Teddy Reig, he asked me whether I would mind making the date, and I said, 'Sure, I'll be glad to' ... And Teddy Reig put the date together, and it turned out a very good date.

ctx.x: I guess that's how the tune got its name.

"Cubop City," yeah. So it was very nice. I enjoyed playing with Machito and them. They were very nice. I liked Mario; he's a very nice person. It was Teddy Reig that recorded that "Cubop City" and so on.
Right. He was with Roost Records then.
